2.2 Employment History
Clinical Trial Assistant – University College Hospital London [11/2024 – current]

Clinical Trial Assistant at the Cancer Clinical Trial Unit at UCLH
Responsibilities:

Facilitate set-up, running, closeout and archiving of cancer clinical trials
Administrative tasks, liaising with pharmaceutical sponsors, PIs, patients, hospital departments, to ensure smoothing running of clinics and collection of data.
Data management for clinical trial, including patient details, clinical data, recruitment statistics, etc.
Perform laboratory procedures (haematology)


Research Assistant – Northwick Park Institute for Medical Research (The Griffin Institute) [09/2023 – 04/2024]

Research assistant at the Contract Research Organization (CRO) department.
Responsibilities:

Plans and delivers bespoke contract pre-clinical trial (animal testing) and report to external clients.
Perform lab experiments, data collection and analysis.
Maintenance of lab and animal facilities, including restocking supplies.
Trained in histology (gross cutting, tissue processing, microtome sectioning, staining, etc.), clinical pathology (haematology testing, blood handling, etc.) and microbiology procedures (antiseptic techniques, etc.), animal facility maintenance (tracking humidity, etc.).
Experience working in a GLP lab (drafting SOP, system validations, etc.)


Final Year Research Project Placement, Summer’s Lab, Department of Genetics, University of Cambridge [02/2022 – 04/2022]

Project on growth relationship between E. coli and Lactobacillus in human gut microbiome

Investigated growth of E. coli in different culture conditions: growth culture supplemented with different products of E. coli and Lactobacillus tryptophan metabolism. Investigated growth of different strains E. coli and Lactobacillus when cultured together. Bacterial growth tracked in CFU counts over 48 hours.
Trained in microbiology. Hands on experience with aseptic technique, bacterial culture, colony forming units (CFU) counts, serial dilution, operating plate reader and O.D measurements, histology techniques (preparing slides, gram staining)
Experience working with genetically modified bacteria, adhering to high standard of laboratory safety regulations. Precision and attention to details.


Summer Intern, Luisi’s Lab, Department of Biochemistry, University of Cambridge [08/2021 – 10/2021]

Project on protein purification and structural identification of Ribonuclease E.

Investigated different approaches to isolate RNase E involving his tag pull down, flag tag pull down, and gel filtration chromatography.
Investigated if RNase E interacts with polysome complex in cells, by using YFP fluorescent gel filtration chromatography.
Investigated if RNase E interact with NUS transcription factors, by carrying out NUS-his tag pull down and western blots.
Hands on experience with general biochemical techniques like gel electrophoresis, western blots, bacterial cultivation, PCR, antibody pull-down assays. Also, learnt specific techniques used in structural biology like HPLC, cryo-EM, qPCR, etc.
Review writing, navigating secondary scientific database, researching scientific literature.


President [2021-2022], Transport Secretary [2020 – 2021],
Cambridge University Hill Walking Club

Duties include leading the club, delegate tasks and ensure smooth running of the club. Act as representative for the club, communicating with other university clubs and external companies.
Communication and interpersonal skills, teamwork, leading and collaborating with committee members.
